notes: PACKET: SWP Mem III p. 6 (Mugharet el Jai) text is cut at 12,000 characters, mid-word ('made their exod'). SWP Mukhmas (III p. 12, linked in Stage 1b) is a different place (village north of Wady Suweinit); distance not shown, so its cisterns, well (E of the village) and rock-cut tombs (N of the village) are coded relative to the village (relative_to other / none). Mukhmas III p. 149 has no feature. Khurbet el Mahmeh (III p. 119, square Ls, 14 km) clearly not this unit or within 2 km: ignored. 'On the north at El Hosn' read as the north side of the valley, so relative_to other. The cistern at 'Khiirbet et Tineh' may be Kh. et-Tinat (S2565) but is coded position none. Own-row cave and cisterns are components of a monastic-complex row: date U.
